title: The OAuth consent page promises you can revoke access from your account settings, but no page lists the AI assistants you authorized
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Filing gate: ③ the maintainer's direct order. Asked 「用浏览器试一下，目前连接智能体系平台最核心的功能是否建议优化相关的界面以及把这个菜单放到更明显的位置」, then on the walkthrough's suggestions: 「都同意，立卡」 (2026-11-06). Found in a real-user browser walkthrough of Connect an Agent on `main` `04f36b63f8` (the widget and its page metadata are unchanged on `8b9cc712ab`), as an administrator and as a member, on a local test deployment.

**Business reason.** A person who lost a laptop with Claude Desktop on it, changed role, or simply stopped using an assistant needs to see what can act as them and turn it off. The consent page tells them they can. Today they cannot find where, and an administrator cannot either.

**Reader.** The UI lane dev, for a list on the Connect an Agent page (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/ConnectAgentWidget.tsx`) and in Account. The data is already recorded: `sys_oauth_consent` (`client_id`, `user_id`, scopes), `sys_oauth_access_token` (`client_id`, `created_at`, `revoked`) and `sys_api_key` (`last_used_at`, `revoked`). The Revoke action needs the server half: #30345 (an MCP access token cannot be revoked today), with its fix in PR #30879.

Blocked-by: #30345
Blocked-by: #30918
Blocked-by: #31048
Blocked-by: #31085

**Duplicates.** Searched `oauth consent revoke` (47 hits; only #30345 and #30879 touch revocation, both server side), `authorized applications account` (8, none) and `connected agents list` (174, none about this list).

## Measured

1. Registered a client named as Claude Desktop through the deployment's client registration, opened its authorization link and approved on `/oauth/consent`. The code came back to the client's redirect address.
2. The consent page's footer reads 「您可以随时在账户设置中撤销访问权限。」 (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts:3125`, drawn at `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/OAuthConsentPage.tsx:274`).
3. Account → every entry. 已关联账户 lists sign-in providers; 活动会话 lists browser sessions; OAuth 应用 (`sys_oauth_application`, view `mine`) answers 「你还没有 OAuth 应用」, because it lists the apps you registered as a developer, not the ones you authorized. Nothing shows the authorization just made.
4. The Connect an Agent page shows the same setup steps before and after connecting.

## Expected

A list of the assistants the person has authorized, and of their API keys, each with when it was authorized and last used and a Revoke action. It sits on the Connect an Agent page under the setup steps and in Account. Revoking ends the assistant's access at once, which is what #30345 provides. An administrator can see and revoke them for a person they manage. Until #30345 lands, the list ships without Revoke or waits, rather than offering a button that leaves access in place.
